purpose: Sources for About and Guidebook. Research recommendations are distinct from host-authored tips. Confirm opening/access information again before visitor publication.

places.name: Mission Hill Family Estate
verifiedFacts: Wine tastings and experiences are offered.
Estate access is for members or by reservation; same-day bookings depend on availability.
places.use: About winery card and Guidebook booking link. No unverified travel time.

places.name: Quails’ Gate Estate Winery
verifiedFacts: The official page lists wine tasting and estate experiences.
The estate also links to Old Vines Restaurant and The Market.
places.use: About winery card and Guidebook tasting reservation link; refer guests to current menus and experience availability.

places.name: Sncewips Heritage Museum
verifiedFacts: Indigenous owned and operated museum sharing syilx culture and heritage.
places.use: About culture reference and Guidebook museum entry. Airbnb supplied an about-10-minute-walk claim; the actual route has not been verified, so omit that duration in guest copy.

places.name: Boucherie Rush Trail
verifiedFacts: Official tourism listing gives a 6 km round trip, approximately 1–3 hours.
Listed difficulty is moderate to difficult; elevation gain is 275 metres.
Trailhead listed at 2775 East Boundary Road.
places.use: About hiking card and Guidebook hiking option with current conditions link. Treat timing as the tourism source’s trail estimate, not travel time from the property.

places.name: Regional parks and trails
verifiedFacts: The official directory lists Kalamoir and Rose Valley as having only some trails open during wildfire recovery.
The directory links to Gellatly Nut Farm, Glen Canyon and Goats Peak park resources.
places.use: Guidebook live trail-condition link. Do not promise that whole parks or every trail are open.

places.name: Bear Creek Park
verifiedFacts: BC Parks describes lakeshore, beach and canyon terrain.
The official search-index advisory says the Canyon Trail network west of Westside Road is closed until further notice.
places.use: Do not present Canyon Trail as an available hike. Direct guests to current BC Parks advisories before any visit.

guestPlanningNotes: Use official venue links for current hours, tasting reservations, availability and trail access.
Avoid invented distances or driving/walking times from the suite.
No unsupplied trail, winery or museum photos are represented as Debra’s property photos.
